content.text: {"id": "mm6827a2", "data_focus": {"v": "yes", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2015, 19.9% of nonsmoking workers reported any exposure to SHS at work"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Exposure prevalence and 95% confidence intervals were calculated for workers in all industry recode categories"}]}, "outcome_types": [{"v": "binary/categorical", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "10.1% reported frequent exposure (twice a week or more)"}]}, {"v": "count/rate", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "The construction industry category had the highest number of nonsmoking workers reporting any SHS exposure (2.9 million)."}]}], "analytic_depth": [{"v": "summary", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "In 2015, 19.9% of nonsmoking workers reported any exposure to SHS at work"}]}, {"v": "comparison", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "reported significantly lower prevalences of frequent exposure to workplace SHS (8.6%) than did those residing"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "with several industry groups reporting prevalences of exposure higher than that of the reference industry group"}]}], "study_design": [{"v": "cross-sectional", "ev": [{"loc": "text", "q": "CDC analyzed data from the 2015 National Health Interview Survey (NHIS) Occupational Health Supplement"}]}], "methods_quotes": [{"loc": "text", "q": "Two-tailed tests of significance (α = 0.05) were performed to compare the percentages"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Exposure prevalence and 95% confidence intervals were calculated for workers in all industry recode categories"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "All analyses were weighted to be representative of U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized adults."}, {"loc": "text", "q": "Data analyses were conducted using SAS-Callable SUDAAN"}, {"loc": "text", "q": "estimates for SHS exposure for some groups were unreliable because of small sample sizes and were therefore suppressed"}], "confidence": "high", "uncertain_fields": []}
